gloss: to be replaced; to be swapped out

definitions.gloss: to be replaced; to be swapped out
definitions.explanation: For one thing to take the place of another. The intransitive counterpart of {置|お}き{換|か}える (to replace); the new item that takes over is marked with に.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{機械|きかい}が{新|あたら}しいものに{置|お}き{換|か}わる。
examples.english: The old machines are being replaced with new ones.

examples.japanese: データが{自動|じどう}で{置|お}き{換|か}わった。
examples.english: The data was swapped out automatically.

examples.japanese: {紙|かみ}の{書類|しょるい}が{次第|しだい}に{電子|でんし}データに{置|お}き{換|か}わりつつある。
examples.english: Paper documents are gradually being replaced by electronic data.

notes:
The intransitive counterpart of {置|お}き{換|か}える (to replace something). What the subject denotes is superseded by, or takes the place of, something else, which is marked with に.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Intransitive: A が B に{置|お}き{換|か}わる (A is replaced by B)
- Transitive pair: {置|お}き{換|か}える (to replace A with B)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自動的|じどうてき}に{置|お}き{換|か}わる: to be replaced automatically
- {徐々|じょじょ}に{置|お}き{換|か}わる: to be gradually replaced
